concepts.def: Survival of individuals best suited to environment
Differences between individuals in a species
Random change in DNA producing new alleles
Inserting a gene from one organism into another
Carrier (e.g. plasmid) used to transfer DNA

walkthroughs.body_html:
Variation → competition → survival → reproduction.

Mutations create new alleles. Individuals with helpful alleles survive and pass them on.

Choose parents with the trait; breed them; choose offspring; repeat.

Used in farming: high-yield crops, meaty cattle, disease-resistant wheat. Risk: narrow gene pool.

Cut a useful gene out with restriction enzymes. Insert into a plasmid using ligase. Transfer into bacteria.

Examples: insulin in bacteria, golden rice, herbicide-resistant crops.
